evals.name: breakdown-spec
evals.prompt: Write a Scout UI spec that verifies selecting `dimension_0` in the metrics-grid breakdown toolbar splits the chart series. Outline the file location, page objects to use, data view setup, and the structure of the spec.
evals.expected_output: Places the new spec under src/platform/plugins/shared/discover/test/scout/ui/parallel_tests/metrics_experience/, models on breakdown_by_dimension.spec.ts, uses pageObjects.discover for shared actions (writeAndSubmitEsqlQuery, optionally addBreakdownFieldFromSidebar) and pageObjects.metricsExperience.breakdownSelector for the metrics-specific assertion (selectDimension, getToggleWithSelection), reuses the existing test-metrics-experience TSDB index and metrics_data_view.json archive, tags for stateful + serverless, and explicitly notes that the breakdown selector splits chart series rather than reducing card count (so 'filter' framing is the wrong semantic).

assertions.name: models-on-existing-breakdown-spec
assertions.description: Recommends modeling on breakdown_by_dimension.spec.ts (the closest existing spec for breakdown work)

assertions.name: cites-discover-PO-for-shared-actions
assertions.description: Uses pageObjects.discover for shared actions (writeAndSubmitEsqlQuery, addBreakdownFieldFromSidebar, etc.) — does not wrap them in a metrics-local helper

assertions.name: uses-breakdownSelector-PO-for-metrics-specific
assertions.description: Uses metricsExperience.breakdownSelector (selectDimension and/or getToggleWithSelection) for the metrics-specific assertion, not raw selectors or a one-off helper

assertions.name: notes-breakdown-splits-not-filters
assertions.description: Gets the semantic right: the breakdown selector splits chart series by the chosen dimension, it does not reduce/filter the number of cards. A 'filter' framing is wrong and the spec should not assert on card count change.

assertions.name: reuses-existing-data-view
assertions.description: Reuses test-metrics-experience TSDB index and metrics_data_view.json archive — does not introduce a new index

assertions.name: tags-stateful-and-serverless
assertions.description: Tags the spec for both stateful and serverless

evals.name: triage-flaky
evals.prompt: fullscreen.spec.ts in the metrics_experience Scout suite has been flaky on main this week. Triage it for me.
evals.expected_output: First step is to pull Buildkite logs (mentions the buildkite-logs skill) to read the actual Playwright trace before guessing. Lists common metrics-suite causes: time-range drift in the TSDB indices (fixed window in global.setup.ts), page-object selector breakage from kbn-unified-chart-section-viewer changes. Explicitly says do NOT quick-skip the spec.

assertions.name: starts-with-buildkite-logs
assertions.description: First step is to pull Buildkite logs / Playwright trace before guessing — mentions the buildkite-logs skill or equivalent

assertions.name: mentions-time-range-drift
assertions.description: Lists time-range drift in the TSDB indices (fixed window from global.setup.ts) as a common cause

assertions.name: mentions-cross-package-selector-breakage
assertions.description: Lists page-object selector breakage from kbn-unified-chart-section-viewer (data-test-subj) changes as a common cause

assertions.name: explicitly-do-not-skip
assertions.description: Explicitly says do NOT quick-skip the spec — fix the underlying code
